audit_metadata.title: KIT GENERATION AUDIT — MPN Decision Logic
audit_metadata.interpretation_note: final_mpn_candidate is an audit reconstruction, not a field currently emitted by CatalogSearchEngine.search. Each case states whether it is publishable or blocked.

executive_result.verdict: The retrieval result already contains identified products, product_scope, BOM and catalog_component_relations_v3_4 evidence, but there is no integrated MPN decision layer that consumes relation_intent after BOM assembly. Existing MPN-producing paths are separate from the v3.4 component-relation lookup.
main_risks: ACCESSORY_REQUIRED can be mistaken for automatic inclusion even though v3.4 defines it as mandatory pairing, not base-product inclusion.
An explicit accessory request is not reconciled with component relations to add exactly the selected PT.
Pairwise UI/UE compatibility can be mistaken for a valid complete multisplit combination.
Discovery-only products can be serialized as MPN even when model or size is not uniquely identified.
Synthetic KIT-* identifiers from compatibility data can be mistaken for real catalog PT codes.

decision_policy_used_by_audit.INCLUDE_IN_MPN: A separately coded physical item explicitly selected or otherwise proven to be part of the commercial shipment. Conditional required alternatives are not serialized until one alternative is selected and the shipping rule is proven.
decision_policy_used_by_audit.OPTIONAL_ONLY: A compatible accessory that is not part of the base product and was not explicitly selected by the query.
decision_policy_used_by_audit.FEATURE_ONLY: A machine feature or catalog statement; it never contributes a PT code.
decision_policy_used_by_audit.INCLUDED_IN_PRODUCT: Included in the base package without a separate sellable code to append.
decision_policy_used_by_audit.conditional_decision_rule: When the catalog proves mandatory pairing but not which alternative is selected or whether a separate shipment line must be emitted, the element keeps decision INCLUDE_IN_MPN with decision_status CONDITIONAL; it is not inserted into final_mpn_candidate.

v3_4_relation_inventory.included_mapping_gap: Included remotes/controls are represented as NO_COMPONENT_CODE plus catalog_inclusion_status=INCLUDED, not as ACCESSORY_INCLUDED_SEPARATE. An MPN composer needs an explicit mapping to INCLUDED_IN_PRODUCT.

cases.test_name: KIT COMPLETO DA CATALOGO CON CODICE UNICO
warnings: This proves the non-decomposition rule for a real catalog SKU named KIT COMPLETO, but it is not an air-air climate product.
No air-air climate product with a real unique KIT_COMPLETO PT was found in unified_catalog_master.

The 1,064 KIT-* records in compatibility master are synthetic bundle identifiers; none matches a catalog PT or MPN and none declares a single-SKU flag. They must not replace a real single catalog code.

required_accessory_control.conclusion: ACCESSORY_REQUIRED is evidence of mandatory pairing, not evidence of base inclusion. The final MPN needs both an alternative-selection rule and an authoritative commercial-shipment rule.

separate_mpn_paths.finding: Builds PT strings from title-derived kit requirements and direct product selectors; it does not consume catalog_component_relations_v3_4 or relation_intent.
Validates or resolves climate BOMs with its own title parser and compatibility logic; it does not consume catalog_component_relations_v3_4 or relation_intent.

architecture_findings.separation_status: BOM/compatibility and component relations are available as separate evidence streams, but no final commercial decision layer joins them.

correct_cases: Test 1: exact FFA25A9 identification, UI_ONLY scope, base MPN 99718206, optional controls/Wi-Fi excluded and pump kept as FEATURE_ONLY.
Test 5: exact Daikin UI+UE physical component set is 50307791 + 50308071 and no accessory code is appended.
Test 7: v3.4 can represent 'pompa scarico condensa inclusa' as FEATURE_ONLY with no PT when a product context exists.
Test 8: a real catalog item named KIT COMPLETO with unique PT 99692315 remains one code and is not decomposed.
ambiguous_cases: Tests 1-2: BYFQ60CS and BYFQ60CW are mandatory alternatives, but no variant is selected and separate shipment is not proven.
Test 3: SPG is a family, not a unique model; the optional Wi-Fi classification is correct but the base PT is unresolved.
Test 4: panel 50370160 is a separate optional/unknown-inclusion accessory explicitly requested by the query; runtime does not reconcile that request into the BOM.
Test 5: compatibility evidence supports the exact pair but runtime compatibility_status remains NOT_VERIFIED.
Test 8: the unique-code example is non-HVAC because no real single-SKU air-air KIT_COMPLETO was found.
decisions_impossible_without_commercial_: Whether an ACCESSORY_REQUIRED item must always be serialized into the commercial MPN or merely displayed as a mandatory separate line item.
Which member of a required accessory alternative group must be chosen when the query gives no finish/model.
Whether an explicitly requested ACCESSORY_OPTIONAL item should always be appended to MPN, and how exact accessory selection is resolved.
Whether runtime NOT_VERIFIED compatibility can be published when lower-level reciprocal evidence exists.
How a real manufacturer single-SKU climate kit is authoritatively distinguished from a synthetic KIT-* compatibility bundle.
missing_rules_for_mpn_generation: Add a post-BOM, post-component-relations decision stage that consumes product identity, product_scope, BOM, relation_intent and query accessory intent.

Define a strict relation mapping: ACCESSORY_OPTIONAL -> OPTIONAL_ONLY unless explicitly selected; FEATURE_ONLY -> FEATURE_ONLY; NO_COMPONENT_CODE plus INCLUDED -> INCLUDED_IN_PRODUCT; ACCESSORY_REQUIRED -> conditional mandatory selection, never unconditional append-all.
Define required-accessory selection groups so mutually exclusive variants cannot both enter the MPN.
Add an authoritative physical-shipment flag distinct from required_for_sale and catalog_inclusion_status.
Resolve explicit accessory mentions to one PT using model/color/title evidence before adding them to the MPN.
Validate multisplit BOMs against complete allowed combinations and quantities, not only pairwise UI/UE compatibility edges.
Require exact or otherwise reliable base-product identity before serializing a discovered BOM.
Serialize quantities as a multiset so repeated identical UIs are preserved.
Define a real single-SKU KIT_COMPLETO flag backed by a catalog PT; never treat synthetic KIT-* identifiers as PT codes.
Expose final_mpn_candidate, decision provenance, warnings and publishability in one runtime result.
final_report.overall_answer: The current system has enough evidence to make several individual decisions, but it cannot yet generate a reliable commercial product sheet and final MPN for all required cases without a dedicated commercial decision layer and missing business rules.
